key_observation: Public CISI Pakistan vol. 2 is not the source-image route for these two Harappa targets: its contents page scopes Harappa black-and-white photographs to H-266..H-1019, while H-1302/H-1303 fall outside that range. Exact OCR target searches find no H-1302/H-1303 target hits; bare 1302/1303 hits are Mohenjo-daro M-number homonyms or index/data noise.
decision: Route H-1302/H-1303 to CISI 3.1, HARP, ICIT/Wells-Fuls data, or source-holder request. Do not keep treating public CISI vol. 2 as likely to contain the panels.
interpretation_boundary: No source image validation, side order, sign correction, value, phonetic reading, language identity, or translation is accepted.
